question: Computational thinking la gi?
expected_answer: La cac qua trinh tu duy de hinh thanh bai toan sao cho loi giai co the bieu dien thanh cac buoc tinh toan va thuat toan.
evidence_quote: computational thinking as the thought processes involved in formulating problems so their solutions can be represented as computational steps and algorithms.

question: Decomposition trong computational thinking la gi?
expected_answer: La viec chia mot bai toan hoac he thong phuc tap thanh cac phan nho, de quan ly hon.
evidence_quote: Decomposition is a fundamental concept in computational thinking, representing the process of systematically breaking down a complex problem or system into smaller, more manageable parts or subproblems.

question: Pattern recognition ho tro giai quyet van de nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Noi giup nhan ra cac cau truc, moi quan he hoac chuoi lap lai trong cac tinh huong giai quyet van de.
evidence_quote: identifying similarities among and within problems

question: Abstraction tap trung vao dieu gi?
expected_answer: Tap trung vao thong tin quan trong va bo qua chi tiet khong lien quan.
evidence_quote: Abstraction is a computational thinking technique that centers on focusing on important information while ignoring irrelevant details.

question: Computational thinking co the duoc ap dung cho quan ly ngan sach hang thang nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Chia chi phi thanh cac nhom, phan tich chi tieu qua khu, tap trung vao khoan co the giam va lap quy trinh ra quyet dinh.
evidence_quote: Decomposition: Break down the financial challenge into different categories such as rent, groceries, utilities, and entertainment.

question: Algorithm duoc dinh nghia nhu the nao?
expected_answer: La mot chuoi cac buoc hoac chi dan phai duoc thuc hien theo thu tu cu the de giai quyet mot van de.
evidence_quote: An algorithm is a sequence of steps/instructions that must be followed in a specific order to solve a problem.

question: Hai cach pho bien de mo ta logic cua algorithm la gi?
expected_answer: Pseudocode va flowchart.
evidence_quote: algorithms are most commonly written as either pseudocode or a flowchart.

question: Tai sao mot ham de quy can co base case?
expected_answer: Neu khong co base case thi qua trinh de quy se khong bao gio ket thuc.
evidence_quote: if you had not specified the base case, the recursive process would never end.

question: Mo hinh thuc thi tuan tu cua algorithm co dac diem gi?
expected_answer: Cac chi dan duoc thuc hien tung buoc theo thu tu.
evidence_quote: the traditional sequential (i.e., step-by-step) execution model for algorithm instructions.

question: Trong DNA sequencing, decomposition duoc dung de lam gi?
expected_answer: Chia chuoi DNA lon va phuc tap thanh cac phan nho hon de xu ly.
evidence_quote: It starts by breaking the large DNA sequence into smaller pieces.

question: Khi nao adaptive design reuse phu hop hon viec tao moi moi thanh phan tu dau?
expected_answer: Khi co the ket hop cac thanh phan thiet ke da ton tai va chi can dieu chinh toi thieu cho giai phap moi.
evidence_quote: adaptive design reuse adopts a top-down methodology, emphasizing the creation and assembly of business solutions by combining existing design components.

question: Design component la gi?
expected_answer: La mot phan tu co the tai su dung trong mot he thong lon hon va phuc vu mot muc dich cu the.
evidence_quote: A design component is a reusable element within a larger system that serves a specific purpose.

question: Heuristic trong boi canh process pattern la gi?
expected_answer: La mot quy tac kinh nghiem duoc hinh thanh khi process pattern tro thanh quy tac huong dan.
evidence_quote: When process patterns that are an inherent part of the process of creating a work product become rules of thumb, they are referred to as heuristics.

question: Layering trong business solution architecture mang lai loi ich gi?
expected_answer: No tach cac concern, cai thien tinh module va giup kien truc de quan ly, de hieu hon.
evidence_quote: This heuristic enables the separation of concerns between layers and improves modularity.

question: Business architecture va information architecture khac nhau ve muc dich nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Business architecture dinh nghia chien luoc, muc tieu, quy trinh va chuc nang cua to chuc; information architecture quan ly tai san du lieu va thong tin.
evidence_quote: Business architecture Defines the organization's business strategy, goals, processes, and functions; Information architecture Manages data and information assets

question: Human-centered computing nhan manh dieu gi khi thiet ke giai phap?
expected_answer: Nhan manh con nguoi thay vi cong nghe trong qua trinh thiet ke giai phap may tinh.
evidence_quote: human-centered computing emphasizes people rather than technologies in the design of computer solutions.

question: Neu muon toi uu hieu qua thuc thi algorithm, mo hinh nao co the duoc dung thay cho tuan tu?
expected_answer: Mo hinh thuc thi song song/dong thoi hoac de quy.
evidence_quote: it is also possible to leverage parallelism/concurrency and recursion as alternative models to drive the execution of algorithms.

question: Decomposition va pattern recognition bo sung cho nhau trong vi du lam sandwich mut nhu the nao?
expected_answer: Decomposition tach cong viec thanh cac thanh phan nho; pattern recognition gom cac thanh phan co dac diem giong nhau vao nhom.
evidence_quote: Decomposition involves solving a complex problem by breaking it up into smaller, more manageable tasks. Pattern recognition makes it possible to group all the different features considered in decomposition into categories.

question: Information architecture quan ly nhung tai san nao?
expected_answer: Quan ly data models, information flow diagrams, data governance, data standards va metadata.
evidence_quote: Information architecture Manages data and information assets Data models, information flow diagrams, data governance, data standards, and metadata

question: Mot kien truc phan mem duoc xem la phu hop khi nao?
expected_answer: Khi no phu hop voi cac yeu cau va muc tieu cu the cua du an hien tai; khong co kien truc nao tuyet doi hoan hao.
evidence_quote: an approach can be deemed highly suitable or relatively perfect if it aligns well with the specific requirements and goals of your current project.
